verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents connecting payroll/HR systems (Gusto, Rippling) so Ari plans from those records, and modeling a hire or a 'hire wave' scenario to see its effect, alongside driver-based cost forecasting. Nothing documents a role-level headcount plan or explicitly shows planned hires flowing line-by-line into the expense forecast. missing for 10: role-level headcount planning, explicit mapping of planned hires into the expense forecast tied to payroll actuals, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can plan headcount at the role level, tied to payroll actuals, with planned hires flowing into the expense forecast

citations.quote: Connect Gusto, Rippling, or another payroll or HR system, HubSpot or Salesforce, Stripe, or a database so Ari plans from your records.
See what a hire, a price change, or a cut does before you commit.
Scenarios you ask for in one line: a hire wave, a slipped quarter, a downside growth case, several at once.
Forecast revenue, costs, and cash from what drives your business.
